question: Where was the Second Buddhist Council held in c.383 BCE?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Second Buddhist council was held in c.383 BCE** approximately one hundred years **after the Buddha's parinirvaṇa** at Vaishali.
 
• The Second Council resulted in the first schism in the Sangha, probably caused by a group of rigorist reformists called Sthaviras who split from the majority Mahasaṃghikas.
 
• After unsuccessfully trying to modify the Vinaya, a small group of "elderly members", broke away from the majority Mahasaṃghika during the Second Buddhist council, giving rise to the Stha
